about: Registry of fusion sites (#617 step A): every place where two or more ops can run as one fused kernel or as separate launches, where it is decided today, the alternatives, and what prices it. Data only; nothing reads it at run time. Each site's deciding function carries a `// FUSION-SITE: <id>` line above its signature, and tests/test_fusion_sites.py fails when the code and this file disagree. byte_promise: Equal (every alternative gives the same bytes), OwnOrder (the alternatives sum in different orders, so the invariant profile must pin one), NotApplicable, Unreviewed. priced.status: priced (the generic route cost model prices the alternatives), partial (some alternative or term), fact (a hardware or format predicate decides, no price), literal (a constant measured on the cards named in the evidence), none (one form only, or a rule with no price).

sites.name: Q8 K/V pair (drafter)
sites.rule_today: fused_domain() gates the registered Q8 G32 shapes; inside it the #565 requested-bytes law (generic::route_traffic) overrides the dual kernel only for the two-launch TwoSimtR8C4 schedule (K=5120, T<=85); the one-launch fused schedules are unpriced.

priced.by: requested-bytes law of generic::route_traffic (not the route cost model)
priced.unpriced: MMA tile efficiency, occupancy, split-K partials, launches

evidence: sweeps on 4060 Ti, 4090, 3060, 2080 Ti recorded in #565

sites.name: gate/up SwiGLU epilogue (Qwen 3.5 dense FFN)
sites.rule_today: linear_swiglu (Epilogue::SwiGlu in the generic Problem) except on the MTP path (mtp flag), which runs linear + silu_mul so its numerics equal the unfused chain; the unfused chain is never priced.

priced.by: flag; the epilogue is part of the Problem and the unfused chain has no price

sites.name: down projection + residual add (Qwen 3.5 dense FFN)
sites.rule_today: linear_add (Epilogue::AddResidual) except on the MTP path, which runs linear + residual_add. The add happens in the FP32 accumulator before the BF16 rounding, a different rounding from residual_add on a stored BF16 projection.

sites.name: GGUF gate/up pair (vec gated pair / MMQ plane + epilogue)
sites.rule_today: Taken whenever gated_halves() holds: the ggml vec gated pair for T <= kGgmlVecMaxTokens, else ggml_mmq_gated_pair, which is not one launch (the tile kernel writes an FP32 plane and generic_mmq_epilogue.cu reads it back in a second launch). Otherwise two projections + silu_mul.

priced.by: fixed rule; the plane read-back is the pointwise term #603 prices

sites.name: shared ggml vec activation quantize
fuses: two or more vec slice groups
sites.rule_today: x is quantized once when two or more parent groups take the vec kernel (a count), else each call quantizes itself.

sites.name: R8 activation quantization: in-kernel vs pre-quantized planes
sites.rule_today: r8_prequantized = R8 family, 2 <= tokens <= kR8VerifyTokens, workspace large enough, format compiled for it. The pre-quantized form refuses PDL join, release and prefetch (see pdl_overlap).
alternatives: separate quantizer launch into workspace planes

priced.by: token range plus measured verify-width bands in generic_gemm.cpp

evidence: comments at the r8 verify widths in generic_gemm.cpp

sites.name: W4A8 / I8 / MMQ activation quantizer launch
sites.rule_today: The quantizer always runs as a separate launch; the cost model charges kQuantLaunchSeconds plus kQuantBytesPerValue per value to every A8 candidate (both Fitted in route_cost_constants.h).
alternatives: separate quantizer launch (the only form built)

sites.name: qk-norm + RoPE (Qwen 3.5 text attention)
sites.rule_today: rmsnorm_rope when tokens <= kFusedTextQkNormRopeMaximumTokens (256), theta 1e7, eps 1e-6, head_dim 256, rotary 64, no YaRN, one position axis; else two rmsnorms + rope. Both branches are the same arithmetic bit for bit.

priced.by: the 256-token bound, measured on an RTX 5090 alone (fused +22..52 % through 256 tokens, -22 % at 1024)
priced.unpriced: wave fill on every other card

sites.name: dense QKV prepare (bias + norm + RoPE + KV write)
sites.rule_today: Always fused for the dense family; no unfused alternative in the code.

sites.name: Gemma 4 QKV prepare (norm + RoPE + KV write)
sites.rule_today: Always fused for Gemma 4 (several overloads: dflash, q-only); no unfused alternative in the code.

sites.name: residual add + norm (dense, Gemma)
sites.rule_today: Always fused for dense and Gemma. Qwen 3.5 instead runs linear_add then rmsnorm (models/qwen3_5/execution/text.cpp).
evidence: #617 analysis, section 1, Q1 (norms rows) and Q5 item 2

sites.name: GDN gated norm + head regroup
sites.rule_today: An alignment predicate (D 64..256 by 64, 4-byte aligned tensors, out apart from x and z) plus the tiled out_proj column order (text.cpp) selects gated_rmsnorm_regrouped over gated_rmsnorm + regroup_bf16_heads.

sites.name: MoE select + plan
sites.rule_today: launch_select_plan (one CTA) when tokens <= kPlanWarps (16), else separate select and plan launches; a shared-memory fact (kPlanWarps x E counters).

priced.unpriced: the saved launch (#617 step K also moves the router in)

sites.name: LM head + top-16 (proposal heads)
sites.rule_today: Proposal heads call linear_topk (no dense logits); other callers write dense logits and select. Not possible with token_mask, logit_bias, penalties or logprobs.

sites.name: KV write inside causal softmax attention
sites.rule_today: The op always appends the current K/V before attending; no separate append alternative.

sites.name: PDL join / release / prefetch between launches
fuses: consecutive projection launches (overlap, not one kernel)
sites.rule_today: Only a register-MMA or R8 Store launch joins or releases; the pre-quantized R8 form refuses all three (OverlapRefusal::PrequantizedR8); prefetch for T <= 16.

priced.by: PDL node cost 1.3-1.5 us against 0.84-0.96 us, measured on a 3090 (src/core/pdl.cuh)

pending.note: Whole-chain pricing algebra (price, select, pair_alternatives, swiglu_alternatives). Not wired to any site yet; when it lands, the sites below are priced by it (steps E and F of #617). It is not a site itself and carries no marker. When its file appears in the tree this entry must move into the sites it prices.
